caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden chest of drawers with a total of nine drawers, arranged in two short drawers at the top followed by three rows of two drawers and three single wide drawers at the bottom section. The chest is rendered in a reddish-brown color, suggesting a polished wood grain texture. Each drawer features two ornate, gold-colored handles with decorative backplates. The chest stands on four cabriole legs with decorative feet. The edges of the chest have subtle molding details at the top and the division between the upper and lower sections. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the detailed illustration of the furniture piece.
title: Chest-On-Chest
